name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
benefit:
> **Certificate** A certificate will be issued to the Intern at the end of her/his internship after evaluation of the research paper or assessment of the work done.
> **Guide** A guide will be assigned to each intern for their study during the internship.
> **Remuneration** The National Green Tribunal pays no remuneration/expenses.
_eligibility_text: The applicant should be a student pursuing three-year and five-year law degree courses in environmental studies/law from any recognized College/Law School/University in India.
